name: RAD54 homolog B
pathways: double-strand break repair via homologous recombination

function.text: RAD54B encodes DNA repair and recombination protein RAD54B. Annotated molecular activities include ATP hydrolysis activity and DNA translocase activity. It participates in homologous recombination and double-strand break repair via homologous recombination.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Biallelic RAD54B sequence mutations have been reported in primary lymphoma and colorectal cancer, although individual findings require functional and clinical assessment.
